notes.title: Fata Deum | Patch 0.1.4 | Out Now
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d053f1ebca698ccd6a320718a621b4affd79eda2.png"]




Patch 0.1.4 is live!


First of all, THANK YOU for all the good feeback that we received on the beta branch it means a lot to us! We’re excited to roll out these changes now for everyone. This update is a first glimpse at the direction we want Fata Deum to take during Early Access – faster, freer, and more divine. Everything here is based directly on your feedback – thank you for helping us shape the game!



📢Main goals of this update:

Unleash divine power: We’re removing restrictions to give players more freedom and a stronger “god” feel. This includes the multi-grab allowing you to migrate mortals to other cities, pick up bigger piles of resources (while just holding left mouse) and improved/increased throwing physics to come with more punch!

[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/e772f599264bf4d573f79c19378409478b809ee8.gif"]    

End the night’s limitations: You decide what and when to do – gods don’t rest when the sun goes down. All actions that are available during the day are now also available at night.

[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/0875ca4cba17032ec591e924f3c76f98f158719b.gif"] 

Reduce micro management: Quicker and more powerful multicast improving cast time and power of effect

[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//38910396/79cd0c0779fa4f92c94dc6b83c1c224e74d19f67.gif"]  

Quicker Building times: a new building won't wait for the next day to be build anymore allowing the player to have quicker impact and less forced micro-management.

Fairer AI: we decreased the "last hit" power of AI gods that received additional mana when having 0 followers as a "hail mary" which felt unfair to players

Improve Stability and Performance: we focused a lot on stability and performance improvements over the last week to make Fata deum more stable and improve the player experience - there is more to come soon though!



Patchnotes 0.1.4:



reduced "last hit power" of AI (AI gets some extra mana when having 0 follower for a final push),

bug fix where settlements under free will always switch to exhausting workload,

mortals are now assigned to a building when dropped in the building area / circle no need to select the building directly anymore,

working mortals stay most of the time now at their work place and have less breaks = easier to find and bless them,

free the night: all actions possible at daytime are now possible at night too, you can also pause and speed-up time during the night (but still possible to skip of course),

migration via drag and drop: migration from one settlement to another can now easily be done via multi-drag/collect and drop: just place them at the main building of another settlement,

two mortals directly start constructing a new building when built during the day,

increased population limit per settlement,

updated tutorials for migration, night time handling and speedup and pausing time,

speedy collect / drag and drop: just hold the left mouse button while collecting,

increased amount of resources and mortals players can collect 

general speed up of all imp hand interactions,

more power / speed on physics while throwing

decreased AI difficulty

reduced cast bolt effect as becoming to large on higher levels

Grabbed objects do not disappear in the night and are are saved and still grabbed after loading a savegame

Improved performance and stability

improved damage logic for godly fist: no more extra damage when directly hitting the ground

removed doubled power entries in tooltip when leveling up



These are just the first steps toward the Fata Deum we envision. Please keep sharing your feedback – it’s shaping the future of the game!

notes.title: Fata Deum | Patch 0.1.3 | Now Available on the Beta Branch
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c0d1348877e3529d09b0a6f88391e90da5a65e96.png"]



The (Community) Gods have spoken! Please keep in mind that it’s only been 4 days since launch, and we are still gathering and evaluating all of your feedback. 



📢Three of the most frequently mentioned issues were: 

Players don't feel free and powerful enough as a god

The day/night cycle feeling too limiting, especially at night, leaving you powerless as a god/player

The repetitive use of wonders, which felt too micro-heavy 

While these are definitely major points that we will rework more deeply in the future, we want to roll out some adjustments right away to already make things feel a bit smoother: 

⚠️WARNING: Please understand that quick changes to bigger systems can always break other stuff - we decided to let you choose if want you want to be a part of that early feature testing. If not please remain in the Default version and wait until the systems are more properly tested and ironed out).


🛠️ Main topics for Patch v0.1.3 


Multigrab for Followers: A god shoudn't have to pick followers one by one. He should be able to carry plenty of them. Well, let's do that!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e772f599264bf4d573f79c19378409478b809ee8.gif"]

Nighttime Wonders/Free the Night: You can now use wonders during the night – whether boosting your villagers or grilling enemies, your divine powers never sleep. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0875ca4cba17032ec591e924f3c76f98f158719b.gif"]

Improved Multicast: Now easier to use/target and comes with more impact, so you’re less forced to cast wonders on mortals one by one. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/79cd0c0779fa4f92c94dc6b83c1c224e74d19f67.gif"]

These are only the first steps, showing the direction we want to take. We’ll share more soon about upcoming ideas to make you feel more powerful and free as a god. 



⚠️ATTENTION: Please keep in mind, these changes come with risks, there wille be some bugs at night and definetely balance issues for a bit  now. We will carefully watch, fix and balance based on your reports. What we need is your feedback letting us know if you like these ideas and your bug reports via F2 to polish them up if you enjoy them!



Please share your feedback regarding the update/direction and if you want to support the development write us an honest Steam review - Thank you!


🛠️Full Patch notes for Patch v0.1.3:


Changes: 

Now multiple mortals can be grabbed simultaneously

Improved multicast handling: easier to execute close to mortals and can now be used in an area if hovering over a building like temple too 

More powerful multicast: cost a little bit more mana, but damage is not so strongly reduced if multiple targets are given => much stronger than single targeting 

Free the night: all wonder are executable at night, too. Collecting and dropping is now possible too 

reduced cast bolt effect as becoming to large on higher levels

Removed migration feature for now: with the multi grab being alive we are already working on realizing migration via multigrabbing and dropping (pick up people and move them to another city - does NOT WORK YET)

Fixes: 

Grabbed objects do not disappear in the night and are are saved and still grabbed after loading a savegame

notes.title: Fata Deum | Release Dev Update | Out on September 15!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/19a6874af32ca9a81ae1d31cdc766e7666bed907.jpg"]

We are proud to announce that Fata Deum will be entering Early Access on 15 September. Since our last development update, we have been focusing on improving the gameplay experience, optimising details and fixing bugs to give you the best possible experience from day one! 



Although we said last time that we would not be adding any more features to the game and would instead focus solely on optimisation and polishing, we have to admit that we have added a few features here and there...



Here is a summary what happened since March:



Improved god spheres

Improved VFX wonders effects

Improved wonder protection

New wonders

One shot wonders

Overview map update

Settlement overview

Anti aliasing / upscaling 

Performance improvements

Fata Deum artbook

Fata Deum soundtrack



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c17f5562078683247eebe13c226294470fc9e7fc.png"]

First of all, we reworked the god's appearances. Our four deities Fertility, Pleasure, Deceit, Violence and the player now have a more unique and enhanced look. Take a closer look. 
[p align="center"]
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f13a197bb857ce7421dcb3107b038c40e94e61d1.png"]
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d0ee4a933c77a1c61658837588b639a1601565d1.png"]

All wonders now have unique VFX effects and are more noticeable when they are executed by you or an enemy deity. Here is a sneak peak on the empower and divert effect.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a84950a3ae0f489f975aa7d680f55222050458ee.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/cabf6056728b3e8d0de91ac8c1bd47b9d3521523.png"]

We adjusted the function of “Wonder protection”. Every mortal and building can be protected against wonder, which works as a shield which needs to be destroyed before damage can be inflicted to the target by a wonder.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4d8675b593200da049f6df1b11858abfbc0fb4ad.gif"]



The wonder protection altar can now protect mortals and buildings from getting damaged. It creates a protection sphere, even if the mortal or building has no protection. 



Settlements close to your god sphere are automatically protected.

 
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4354b3145b3ec59683e15ba6263185de0f72889e.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e6c5fad8dbc750e90b42fb155a2fb27db639bb34.png"]

In addition to the reworked VFX effects, we added six new wonders into the game (yes, we said we wouldn't add any more new content, but we just couldn't resist!). Grow trees, make mortals dance, speed up the building process, capture them, protect them, or destroy an entire village!  



Miraculous Fertility:



You don`t have to die to get to paradise as long as you have a garden. 
Felled all trees around your village to construct buildings? No worries, use “Miraculous Fertility" and let new trees grow within seconds.    

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0f12f0d43f9ab7ce9db35642ca7ab335ac441faf.gif"] 

Dance Fever:



Dance the night away! Bored to see hard working mortals? Slow down productivity by using “Dance Fever” to distract them and push their energy. Or just end fighting and let them all dance! 


[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2da903d5b267a2035a2b85af6adda68ca4dc70ad.gif"]

Building Boost:



The end of shortage of skilled workers. Build buildings faster or repair damaged ones, your choice!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e018a7f6ea9d5e91db1880005690945ac1baaaf6.gif"]



Protection Stasis:



Immortality lasts the longest. Protect your favorite mortals by freezing them in stasis. No matter what will happen around them, they will be protected.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/575f7ad6189646dbdc1eafe0f046670c69b95c73.gif"] 

Diabolic Shackles:

 

Why not stay forever? Trap mortals with diabolic shackles. Reducing their life points and productivity.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fcf0b9654856ab283dfd12d379f6e05f5fccb5ef.gif"]

Big Berta:



Bored of many small comets doing minimal damage? Summon the mother of all comets, Big Berta. Destroy a whole village with one strike!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47412eab16e388ff06f2d2bceb23c4840f495302.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/6afa522c2f7ebfe62f51e7fa9675d3b524c60367.png"] Besides earning skills from the skill tree, you are now able to earn one shot wonders. But what are one shot wonders? Choosing a one shot wonder, will give you the ability to use a big late game wonder early on. But execute wisely, you will only have one shot to make the perfect use of it!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a6babbbc20c8c7f07d8cac4dfcc3b9e16940bb1c.gif"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/564f37d389448b99cdb729182cc7280e0a9d8b8c.png"]

We enhanced the functions of the overview map. You are now able to see the paths between the villages and cities. We added the view menu to the overview map too. Select an icon from it and you will see it appear above village icons to show you the statistics. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4ffb2ef1c183e7897472596ae67f26ad8433d89a.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b47ea201b2939f06bcc0424f42fb22dd9e5bd320.png"]

We added more icons to the settlement UI, to make it easier for you to manage your village. Furthermore, you will now see incoming and outcoming trades, energy gains and losses and how much resources are produced by mortals per day. 

 
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/72da017904e6bac3781c1706951735c27613965c.png"]

 

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1b43af6ae205661c7c203af92459dde9289843de.png"]We added Anti Aliasing to the game. It calculates the game in a lower resolution and afterwards, the image is enhanced with a better frame rate and performance. We will support DLSS and FSR with multiple quality levels.



[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47b00e410c12cb45eddcbe77135d0fd28275ac92.png"]

We kept working hard to improve the performance of the game and can proudly say that with our minimum requirements, you should be able to play the game at 30 fps. With high spec PC`s you can target 60fps and more.



[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/092eeb9ea5ed183f35d1c32391b7b159691f7d62.png"]

Together with the game, we will release an artbook and a soundtrack. Keep an eye out on our store page on release to find them. Here is a small sneak peek from our artbook. You can also buy a Supporter Edition including the game and both the soundtrack and the artbook.
[p align="center"]
[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/aabf9aad63629d902b546fa225430b7094c1a892.jpg"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/6e4b62641ecec81424fd5c3726f1de1e635b2577.png"]



As Fata Deum will be released on the 15th September, you will have access to our 4 handcrafted islands Skultho, Verdesis, Yundur and Urdiria. Choose between four enemy deities: Fertility, Violence, Deceit or Pleasure. You want to play in peace? Simply choose no enemy deity and you will have the island for yourself (besides these heretics believing in Mother Nature!).

 

Be good, be bad, do whatever you like! Focus on making wonders and direct interaction with mortals during the day or focus on indirect control during the night with manipulations. Depending on your decisions the world will react, so choose wisely!

 

Our advanced physics-based destruction system helps to demolish or destroy buildings with your godly powers. Punch buildings, mortals or resources. Grab and throw them around with the Godly Hand. 



Choose from over 30 different wonders (good and evil ones) and shape the world according to your will!

 

Use our free building with drag and drop mechanisms and 20+ building types to expand your villages and cities.

 

Take some time to explore some of our 56 locations. Some have quests, others offer rewards. Will you be able to find them all?



While playing, you can choose different skills with two different subsets of daytime and nighttime powers, making every playthrough unique! 



The Fates will introduce themselves to you, offering 8 Fate Challenges with one challenge from each Fate. Through these you will unlock new difficulties, islands, start progressions and special game set ups.  

 


[p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/de409bd209be5fa984bdc318bcc16a5e8f751e37.png"] 

We can`t wait for you to hop on the game on the 15 September!



And there is even more for you coming soon.

 

We will continue implementing your feedback, and are already aiming to implement new buildings, wonders and quests. So stay tuned!

 

You can give us direct feedback in-game via F1 (feature request) or F2 (bug report), or just contact us via Steam forum or Discord.



Furthermore, you can vote for specific features being implemented and thereby influencing our roadmap for the EA phase!

 

See you all soon. 




Fata Deum Dev Team

notes.title: Dev Update March 2025: Game Setup, Fate Challenges, Improved Buildings,....
notes.content:
Since October we`ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress.

Here is a quick summary:

 Game Setup + Meta Progession 
 Intro Cutscene + Fate Challenges
 Voice Over
 Quests & Rewards
 Improved Village Buildings 
 Animation Varience
 Advanced Demolition System
 Wonder Load Status Icon
 Mortal Motivation
 Steam Rewards

[hr][/hr]New Game Setup Menu & Meta Progression


When starting a new game, you now have the opportunity to specify your game setup. 

On which island do you want to play? 
Which enemy gods do you want to go up against? 
How difficult should it be and what should your start progress look like?

Specials: If you want to go crazy, choose a special game setup. 

Normal mortals do not fly high enough when you hit them? Smash them into space with our “Lunar Gravity”. 

You want to start a zombie apocalypse? Go for it with the “Night of the living dead” special. 

Or do you want to have an advanced start with a lot of villages or fully build cities? Then start with the “Advanced Villages” or “Cities” special.

But not all options are available from the beginning and you need to unlock these due to several challenges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fed113d25963088389d0b77fac04130fab537fda.png

[hr][/hr]Intro Cutscene & Fate Challenges

Each Free Play will start with a great intro cutscene introducing your creators: The Fates. 

They will not only guide you and tell you more about the world. From time to time they will reach out and will give you the opportunity to choose between 3 challenges. 

So you can choose your fate!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/5b36ff1e1f4438ad9c1094008aaa0633d5eb5259.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/998ee1a87d1a1a3e5a7c2da629c326d72acddc89.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e2ecadd329a9d48c7e4ba7c47e538201ae95ed93.png

Once a challenge is fulfilled the corresponding Fate blesses you and increases your already growing powers!

[hr][/hr]Quests and Rewards

All of our islands are now filled with exploration spots. Fly around the island and visit them. In some cases you find interesting quests, in others you will earn a reward for exploring.

Temple:

[hr][/hr] Animation Variation 

Along with the improved building assets, buildings are now bustling and there are a variety of animations. For example, you can now see people drinking, trading, dancing, or sleeping at the tavern. Take a closer look at each building and you will see many different things going on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c922500a020253fecc7fa7fb99c17bf24f2cddf7.gif

notes.title: Dev Update October 2024: Free Building, Advanced Physics, Mortal Reactions,....
notes.content:
For those of you eager for a god game that offers genuine creative control, this update is exactly what you’ve been asking for. After sharing our demo at Steam NextFest, we took in a lot of your feedback. The key takeaway? 

You want more freedom, interaction, and a world that reacts to your influence. We’ve taken your feedback to heart and implemented various substantial changes to give you just that.

So we checked our timetable again, reprioritized, squeezed additional budget out of our great publisher, and went back to work!

And this is what we have delivered:

 Free building 
 Advanced physics
 Damage resources to extract stones
 Throw items like stones, gold nuggets and trees
 Grab and plant trees 
 Advanced mortal reaction system
 Cutscene sneak peek
 Quests
 Tutorial Manager
[hr][/hr]Free Building

Build the way you want with our new free building system. 

You can start building by choosing a building from the shortcut menu and a nice location. Hold the left mouse button to rotate the building. 

Does your desired building already exist? Then, you can drag and drop the building! 

The road is created automatically, so you do not have to bother yourself with such micromanagement stuff if you do not want to!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/7781ab532cef051150c49502a96e90127cb66fb5.gif

[hr][/hr]Advanced Physics

We further advanced the physics of the game. You can now damage resources to get throwable items. These items can be used to damage buildings or crush mortals. The choice is up to you. If your throw is good enough, you may achieve both. 

But you can also collect the resource nuggets and send them as a gift (boring!).

[code]               {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/35fd261001c022509b9e799908041584760e63e0.gif

               {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/170c094891dba54584437601b7e069b8e00d3e15.gif[/code]
Is your village missing some trees, or does a tree just bother you? No worries. Grab the tree, look for another place that suits him, and place him there. The mortals will be happy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/3f918faf2dd3a060a631c7e599e34479c2e7c454.gif

[hr][/hr]Advanced Mortal Reaction System

You are a god. Everything you do influences the world. And so does the reaction of the mortals. Do something good, and they will cheer. Do something bad, and they will be scared.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e07a54a22a1b10b77038fc719c2cb2f56dc9a942.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c5ddcc668f32d8631b2e5c33b6db2ec2ed311e12.gif
[code]               {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1d94956f438e508a93b98a365f918dad8af42b3b.gif[/code]
[hr][/hr]Cutscene 

The narrative of Fata Deum will be told via special cutscenes and in-game quest scenes. 
Just take a look 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/48dd511a1d96093d32e837deea168bba2d631ed2.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/05dd46a3a58f8f276027c6813225fe13ef1b7822.png
[hr][/hr]Quests

A first round of quests is now implemented. As we continue developing, more quests will enter the game. There will be many ways to accomplish a quest. And for those who don't care about them, no worries, you can mostly ignore them, too. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fde8a0beeeb733997001386979f9d074df5154af.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/007782b90dedca01e0a3875496c3e46b49a1ed81.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/0edd9e1553ebb125b85f0083f5792376699a0cef.png
[hr][/hr]Tutorial Manager

We have received a lot of feedback from you regarding the tutorial. Some of you wanted to start playing immediately without it; others had the problem that they sometimes missed or skipped it while playing. 

So, we redesigned the tutorial flow to let you decide how and when to proceed.

With every new ability you learn, you will be asked if you want to do a tutorial or not instead of just pushing you to do it. Furthermore, we added three new tutorial buttons: “Pause”; “Skip”; “Go Back”. You can use these to watch the last sentence again, pause, or skip the tutorial.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/c0752e0b87aaac3b6f1f809d1c051836e0c65f0b.png

Pressing the Imp will open our new tutorial menu. All tutorials in the game are displayed here as soon as you have unlocked them. You now have the freedom to do tutorials whenever you like!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/fed3563345e29bba5361b57e60c5821390ce535c.jpg

[hr][/hr]Release Date

OK, this was a lot, wasn’t it? :) 

And it was worth the effort!

But yes, it takes time..

We want to give you the best experience on day one. Therefore, we will push the release window to 2025 to implement your great feedback and ensure the game is polished.

Thanks again for your patience!

The god game genre will be back in 2025!

notes.title: Fata Deum Development Update - April 2024
notes.content:
Skill Tree, Narrative Design & Mythical Locations

Since November, we’ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress. Here is a quick summary:

 Tutorial & Skill Tree
 Narrative Design & Mythical Locations
 AI Improvements
 Improved Fire Effect
 Enhanced Sound

Tutorial & Skill Tree

Our main focus in the last months has been implementing your tutorial feedback. 

We slimmed down the dialogues and adjusted the pacing. Relevant things will only be explained when they matter. At the same time, the tutorial has new content and is more polished than ever. All this could be accomplished with the help of our new skill system. 

A new skill system? Yes, you heard right. As a part of the tutorial improvement, we implemented a skill tree as a new gameplay feature. You will have much more freedom of what you want to skill/learn and how you would like to develop yourself as a god. 

A new level-up allows you to upgrade a Wonder or Manipulation. The Imp will then shortly introduce you to your newly chosen ability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a77587e72161cec8c17a94e0fd2ec3f2e7010107.jpg
The more you level up, the more skills you can learn. All skills have multiple levels, which can make them even more powerful.

We also reworked the player skill UI to be more clearly arranged and readable. Here, you can see all of your already unlocked skills and their effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a7ac4e63304d67e35959748004187006ede0d809.jpg
Narrative Design & Mythical Locations

Our narrative team started working on story-driven quests to provide even more things to explore and experience on each island.

Since then, some strange things appeared. What mysteries could they hold?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f001289c45255001dfe8c0873b389bb318c728ba.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4942b4b802649e56aa130ba368153cc0583f0895.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/511863860f75054c7e58b605be7397d57bbdddc6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/3f4238d7d4778959ba199acd82c73f4326cb7f88.jpg
AI Improvements

We kept working on our AI system. It can now manage cities, including resource chains, building monuments, and upgrading equipment in neighboring villages. Furthermore, it has learned new actions like building outposts and summoning fireworks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e80a12f30584720a38c237eca929f0dc7e8399c9.jpg
A new type of prayer that appears less frequently gives more Prayer Points but is also more difficult to fulfill. Above all, it leaves more choices about how it is fulfilled, as it simply requires that certain properties fulfill a certain value.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/44bc1333305119fc08a9ebdef153b1cbfb9ecf48.jpg
Improved Fire Effect

We improved the fire effect to be even more satisfying. Take a look!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9b36db11714a402da5fd9d9988faaab958093d51.gif
Enhanced Sound

Prick up your ears. We reworked the sounds to bring you a more immersive experience. We added sound to the UI elements and switched sounds on Demons, Farming, Villages, and Cities to better suit the game. In addition, volume levels have been adjusted, and slight effects such as reverberation have been added for a more harmonious image. 

Next Steps

 New Wonders will find their way to Fata Deum.
 We are currently working to get physics running.
 We will expand the main story of Fata Deum and implement side quests.
 We will further polish and balance the game for the best experience.

We’ll let you know when the new demo is ready, and we thank you for your patience so far

notes.title: November 2023 Update: Gameplay Features, UI Changes, AI, New Map, and more!
notes.content:
Since July, we’ve been working hard and are proud to present our progress as we head towards the end of the year. Here is a quick summary:

 Two new gameplay features
 A choosable AI difficulty and further AI improvements
 More UI improvements
 A first look at our newest and biggest level created, with up to five gods
 Improved performance
 And much more…

Gameplay Features
Based on your feedback we implemented a highly requested feature – a mortal collecting system. You can now grab any mortal you want, drag them around, and assign him to a new task just by dropping them in place!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/88b8e9de117bfe4e385b9f7c820946403199e14f.jpg
Show off your godly strength by using the new ring selection. It gives you the ability to use wonders in a wide circular range. Everything within the circle – whether mortal or building – will be influenced by your wonder.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ec5bd3e9212b17f1b1efd6600275485fa016a35e.jpg
UI Changes
We have reworked the overview maps of the islands. Wonder how they look now? Take a look!

At day:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/226db1bf1c106497930ddf477b122c01048bc5a0.jpg

At night:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/726d2f5a71170a8cd4976e5d604d05d9d1090b40.jpg

Up until now, collecting resources has been confusing for many of you. We fixed that by adding new UI icons so you always know how many resources you have collected and where you can drop them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f5f33f009fc18836c570aec103caf35385b8eab2.jpg

AI Improvements
We kept on working on our AI system. First, we implemented difficulty levels so you can now choose between three options: Easy, Medium, and Hard.

Furthermore, the AI is now smarter than ever. Every god acts with foresight, builds up their conquered villages, connects trading routes, and follows their own strategies. If you do not watch your villages and villagers, your godly status will be in great danger! 

New Map
Take a look at our largest Island yet that can handle six gods at once – Will you be able to compete here against five other opponents?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1489a462fb49ded6e8d4e647893e7690a960940f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e298fedbe1ca2df1f57c4b1f4240a6ffd5f8d425.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/187fb7d3b2ca39f5c0f175753de2d993b381fb5b.jpg

Performance
We’ve continued to work on the performance of the game. Below, you can see our result: 900 big city buildings together with 10,000 small city buildings rendered above 100 FPS in the Unity editor. Not so long ago, this was impossible!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/38d748ca13d35ad7445f5d107cbb18eccdde725d.png

At the same time, we reduced the loading time significantly so you can jump quickly into the game. Memory usage has been reduced significantly, too. This is very important for all gamers without high-end hardware and will be noticeable right away, especially in end-game situations. 

Improved Vegetation
We polished the Vegetation of the Gods and implemented new assets to make everything look cool.

Violence now looks more dangerous than ever.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/18820d7fb79951946c414cda07d99d3729c5da2e.jpg

Deceit`s lands at night. It may look cool, but where these mushrooms are, zombies aren't far away.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/555d4d1f0ed9037a58af8ec0d03c6ec90e7a9954.jpg

What beautiful flora! This must be Fertility’s domain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2c4be3596ee8c7caa7cfc736c7757930739dd10f.jpg

Looking for a nice holiday? In the land of Pleasure you will surely find what you seek…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/57c8bb3fc35e6d12fe6ffd52f67c5d46ede8b8f6.jpg

New Demon Animation
Look at these new Demon fighting animations. Will they be enough to crush your enemies?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ae9741115f6708bef29c7b7c55221c0a142153a7.png

Next Steps
We’re on track for our new target of releasing next year, and one of our first priorities will be on a new demo to showcase all the improvements we’ve made this year. Specifically:

 The already teased map from our last development update will await you! On this map, you can play against two other gods and conquer up to 18 villages and cities.
 Longer playtime per session.
 An improved tutorial to give players a better introduction to the game.
 Better controls – from the camera, to collecting resources, keybindings, and more! 
 Improved AI opponents.
 Enhanced performance all round.

We’ll let you know when the new demo is ready, and we thank you for your patience so far. See you next year!

notes.title: June 2023 Update: New UI, AI, Levels, Cutscenes, Achievements, …
notes.content:
Fata Deum has evolved a lot during the last months in several areas:


 Several new UI features have been introduced and the overall UX has been adapted based on the community feedback.
 After a long period the new god AI is finally ready and four different AI characters are eagerly waiting to challenge the player.
 Another level for three gods has been created with the godly powers of our level designer
 Campaign cutscenes have been designed.
 25 achievements can now be achieved.
 and much more…


Improved UI

We have added three new UI elements, which have been requested by our community. Thanks for the feedback! 

Settlement Overview: this provides all important details of the current settlement at the top of the screen. Furthermore, it is possible to navigate to the next or previous settlement with one click.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/97697bd40b7b1c6fe10e5ba6eeb7cbe5d062556e.jpg

The View Menu: this menu allows you to search for specific attributes in your current surroundings. Looking for mortals with low health to help them to recover (or bring it to an end..)?  Looking for those who follow another god? Need to know who is most productive?The strongest warriors? This is the way to go: just select the corresponding attribute and all important details are directly rendered on top of the surrounding mortals. You can either lock your setup for further investigations or shortly hover over an icon to get a first impression. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4eae57abf06648b02f85be89fb76d6aef4bd19ee.jpg

The Shortcut Menu: the shortcut menu provides you direct access to all wonders and available settlements. Thereby, you can easily move from one important part of the current match to another with the click of one button. You can now be everywhere at once, just like a real god!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f9ef8af778e9b3f95ade9d4c8dc2809a78482877.jpg

The settlement shortcuts also provide a good overview of the current belief distribution in each settlement.

Furthermore, you can directly execute each wonder by selecting it and pointing at a target.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/a7a0bef4c20485ec48ba1a0162a53668a27c064f.jpg

It is possible to configure the shortcut menu as you like and also mix settlement and wonder shortcuts in one row.

You can add as many configurations as you want and switch between them easily.

You can also create shortcuts for specific positions on the map, not just for settlements.

Being a god has never been so easy!


The New AI

Our new AI system, which has been in development for a very long time, is now active and ready for a challenge! Four different AI characters (Fertility, Pleasure, Deceit, Violence) act very differently while still being able to react to the player’s behavior.

Do you want to see how your followers are hit by thunder strikes day by day, while a mass of soldiers are trained to conquer your lands? Violence is your choice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/f8bcf35e1e96ba0d6e95ca21fb36574ce6c56c50.jpg

Prefer to see how your followers get cursed and start to attack each other for no reason until a massive horde of zombies takes over your village? Deceit will be your match!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4afaefe65da7a4a3a9f34146ce62113d5f644932.jpg

Do you want to keep up against inhuman growth and beauty? Seeing villages and cities evolving in no time? Meet up with Fertility! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e2e24be8e260373f0f19619b3abda869d17965d5.jpg

Or do you just wanna have fun? Pleasure is your opponent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/567ea5809689439e70dca7d4af8a52858438d6d4.jpg

While the described characteristics of each character are already there, they still need further work to be improved and match our vision. 

Furthermore, each AI character is not only acting individually but will also comment on the player’s action in its own style.

notes.title: February 2023 update: Levels, Camera, Performance, Audio, and AI
notes.content:
Hello again! We’re back after another break, this time because we were focused on organizational matters. We’ve hired four additional staff members (three software developers and one level designer). We needed some time to train up and become productive.

And, wow - have we been productive 🙂

Level Design

Nico, our level designer, first learned how to work with our tools and to understand what is a feature and what is a bug in our very customized level designing toolchain. After some teething issues at the beginning, he's become very productive quite fast.

And below are the first results of a skirmish map for up to four gods:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9f39a11e4ae3a176dc382b9fd4322fb3298ba235.jpg
The new four gods map is ready for action!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/5689d096c6adf61fce9a618886495ffc7b4e612e.jpg
Many mortals available! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b0ba902b7fb9bee6a984a76fbf26f42d7390805a.jpg
Four gods, four cities (and many more villages) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/50a2b4d3255b1990f3bf063bef93b790a274f7b7.jpg
Who will succeed?!

While this map still needs some polishing, a second map for up to three gods is already in the making:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/73890657cc8af1fbcea5d564ff8f5800e1aef2e4.jpg
A three gods map is already in the making!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/1497967d28c192879c422e58d41cdec9b25c612f.jpg
Nice place for a holiday ?!

The massive amount of buildings and characters being simulated and rendered in the end game of a five gods maps directly highlights the second very important topic we are currently working on:

Performance

There are several very complex issues if you want to bring a game like Fata Deum to life (large numbers of characters, complex AI logic, many buildings, etc.). Especially, if most of it shall also be visible at a distance. 

One major bottleneck in the end game was the rendering of a large amount of characters. We do not want to bother you with technical details but we needed to test many different techniques and faced many technical issues until we found a solution. This ended up being a combination of several techniques that satisfies our high standards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/21311eba40f577010a4ee11aa0a974a557c75c14.png
Test scenario: rendering as many diverse characters as possible at the same time!

Geri worked really hard to find this solution and the results are very promising: he was able to push us from 20 FPS in end game situations with a large amount of characters to over 60 FPS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d71a1fa7499e5a854b2248c042c263ed3d7ef7a7.png
Before: low frame rate because of many characters rendered at the same time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ff8606657c2cd215ba5994f150147d1f597ed472.jpg
After: 60 FPS even many characters are rendered at the same time!

And these are frames captured inside the Unity editor, so performance is even better with a real build!
 
We will proceed to increase the overall performance, so that we will be able to provide you a smooth experience in all cases.

Camera Controls

The camera controls are the functionality which has been most criticized in the feedback form we have collected from all of you. So, we decided to put Jan on this job to focus on it!

One main issue here is to provide a smooth experience even when switching between different height levels and using different distance and view angles. While many strategy and simulation games have quite fixed camera angles and distances, Fata Deum allows you to move freely. This is great, but makes camera control quite complex.

As the overall complexity has been understood over time and the camera logic was technically a wild-mix of different camera control styles, Jan decided to rewrite the whole logic. While this part is done and we already have a much better experience, Jan will further improve and polish the logic over the next months while working on other tasks. 

Jan also added the functionality for individual key bindings, which can now be defined by each player in the main menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/505cd4777e2fba27a8980eb9952a1cf4c142f901.jpg
Key bindings!!

Audio Improvements

There have been some issues on the audio logic which resulted in sounds being played much more often than intended, resulting in a more or less quite annoying gaming experience once the scenery became more crowded. Jakob, another new hire, did fix this at the very beginning. Our ears are very thankful 🙂

Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery

As we are now working in a much larger team with four software developers in parallel, it was also necessary to improve our workflow on an organizational and a technical level. Jakob implemented a Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery system, which allows us to automatically check the newest builds which are pushed onto the server and receive a fresh new version automatically every night. While setting this up was quite time-intensive, we can now proceed with focusing on our tasks and not having to waste time on time-intensive builds or code checks!

AI Dialogs   

Jakob has also started work on AI related topics. As the AI is quite complex it will need some time until he can take over this part. One thing he is currently working on is the introduction of AI dialogues, so the AI god character reacts to specific situations, e.g. a simple greeting at the beginning of a match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/7538166dc0faf328ee3cd7c73b8a3b01c093f06b.jpg
God Deceit speaks his first words!

Next Steps

We are planning to provide you with new updates every couple of months or so. In terms of what the team will be working on next:


 Nico will continue on creating new maps and improving the vegetation visually.
 Jan will further improve the camera logic and furthermore improve the UI.
 Geri will continue with improving performance.
 Jakob will focus on AI mostly.

Chris was mainly focusing on supporting all others with their tasks and bug fixing whatever stands in their way. But he hopes to continue working on AI across the next few months. 

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Development Update: Release Schedule, Steam Next Fest and AI
notes.content:
We are sorry for being silent over the last months, but after the very intense time at the begin of the year (publisher deal and Steam Next Fest), we decided to calm down a bit, check the feedback, take a breath, check the feedback again, talk to our brand-new publisher, sit back, check the feedback again, do some planning, talk to the publisher and continue to work 😊

Based on the feedback and the possibility to get access to additional budget (via our publisher) we decided that increasing the team size, especially for software development, would be the best step for the project.

To achieve this, we needed to change things organizational and code-wise. So currently we are still in this transformational process while improving the AI in the meantime (code-aspects are really high-priority right now).

As AI improvements or the mentioned organizational aspects are quite difficult to demonstrate via an update, we have not much to share right now, sorry!

But things are going very well for Fata Deum and the mentioned steps will results in an improved development speed during this year and also allows us to already have much better support at the begin of the EA phase (instead of ramping these things up after getting new budget during the EA release).

So, it is very great that our publisher supports us in this direction!

The Steam Next Fest has been a great success and we received a lot of new input (2000+ filled out queries…) so this needed time 😊 

The cooperation with the publisher means more money and more quality for Fata Deum before we release to EA, but it also means: a later release! 

Thereby, we decided to move the release date to 2023. 
A good god game needs time!

Steam Next Fest Was a Great Success!

Over 25.000 gamer played the Fata Deum demo and over 2.000 feedback forms have been filled out!
We have been able to more than double our Steam wishlists count and have now more than 100.000 outstanding wishlists (still increasing day by day). For an indie developer these wishlists numbers are very important to get enough coverage by Steam during release. 
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/134a032e3f9c94d1c7f70f1f1f14df2a59fc4f83.png
We have more than doubled our wishlist numbers during the Steam Next Fest! (https://steamdb.info/app/1330360/graphs/)

Having 100.000 wishlists is a great success for a small indie team like us and this would not have been possible without your support.

Thank you so much! 

Our publisher Hooded Horse did also a great job during the Steam Next Fest so we could reach a new level of visibility. We are now on position 132 in the Steam global wishlists charts. Considering that more than 10.000 games are launched at Steam every year, this is just amazing!

Feedback Evaluation
2.000 filled out feedback forms during the Steam Next Fest… that’s a lot 😊 
And we have taken them seriously analyzing each of these feedbacks!

While the overall picture is already quite good, we still have issues with controls and the tutorials ☹
So, this is something we will add another iteration for!
We also received a lot of nice ideas we will would like to put in the game either before or after EA release! 

Of course, we would love to read that everyone is already totally happy with the game and ship it, but we are willing to get the mentioned issues fixed and ship afterwards!

That is what feedback is for😊 And our publisher sees things very similar.

Next Steps

We will now take a break (summer holidays) and continue to work afterwards! Next available Alpha build will be the big AI patch! So, stay tuned! A real godly opponent will kick your ass soon 😉 (this brand-new experience will only be available for Kickstarter Alpha backers, sorry)

notes.title: Game Localization, Steam Next Fest and AI Development
notes.content:
The Fata Deum Christmas Bakery

First of all, we want to use this update to wish everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Enjoy your (hopefully) free days with family and friends and stay healthy 😊

At the end of each year the mortals of Fata Deum meet at their local bakery to prepare a delicious Christmas meal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4355a0534bfae38e65b2906b35e196aecb3700e3.jpg

Even if they believe in you, of course!
A bakery doubles your food production and can be built in cities only!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2a603074382385c24bbb29d61110dcf434456c92.jpg

Just as a side note 😉

And now for something completely different: 


Game Localization

During the last year we have received a lot of requests for a localization of Fata Deum for a specific language. Initially we planned to provide a localization of Fata Deum for English and German only (for EA release). But based on your feedback and the high interest we decided to provide a localization for the following languages for the EA release already:

English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean

And we have already achieved a lot in this regard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/2fa4dc7bb6d40d503f1d911989fe378adb315c98.jpg

A first “very basic placeholder” translation has been done for all languages to check for technical problems (font issues, different sizes, special grammar cases etc.). These checks have already been finished and after some fixes here and there everything works fine!

We are currently in negotiations with different companies to translate all texts for the EA release!
So, this is set in stone! 

Most people on this planet will be able to play Fata Deum in their native language right from the beginning!

The imp learned some Chinese and Russian words already 😊

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/e03ffbe9d189cf699d7da65172f055e52085da28.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/4578b1aeed49ddd8229acf6bf4716f62f286e8f3.jpg


Steam Next Fest

As described in our last update we improved the Fata Deum demo a lot based on your feedback. During the last two months we further improved the tutorial and we are now ready to give the demo another go! 

But we will wait until the next big event:  

The Steam Next Fest (end of February). 

Until then we will of course keep improving the game (and the demo)! 
Stay tuned! Further updates regarding our participation in the Steam Next Fest event are planned for next year 😊 


AI Development

The AI is getting smarter day by day! 
Maybe we should get started to be scared (world domination, etc.) 😉. 

The whole AI system, which is used to control the AI gods, the settlement and the prayer logic is finished technically. We are currently fixing bugs and apply a proper balancing / configuration for the different profiles (different gods, different settlement profiles, etc.). 

We expect to finish the work on the AI (for the EA release) at the end of January. This is the last big piece of code which needs to be done!

The heart of the AI system is a planner which is able to calculate complex plans (for world domination or getting a coffee) based on its current status and a large set of available actions.

It is like: 

 You want to build a large city? 
 For this you need stone, mortals, wood, food. 
 For this you need a quarry, a residence, a lumberjack, a farm.
 For this you need wood, too.
 For this you need to push your people to work.
 For this you need to multiply your mortals.
 For this you need food, too.


Calculated plan: GetWood, BuildFarm, GetFood, MultiplyMortals, PushMortalsToWork, GetWood, BuildLumberjack, GetWood, BuildQuarry, GetWood, BuildResidence, GetStone, GetWood, GetFood, MultiplyMortals, BuildCity

The AI is able to react on changing situation, reprioritize its goals and calculate an adapted plan whenever needed (player has a big military force?! => BuildDefenceTower, BuildBarracks, TrainSoldiers).

One thing we need to teach the AI:
-which actions are available
-under which precondition the action can be executed
-what are the effects of an action

This does look like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/b02aaf09b6e8d02829806f8f0adc15c311e90a42.png

Based on these definitions the AI is able to calculate a chain of actions to get to its goal (building a city...). Hopefully, you liked this little technical excursion 😊


Next Steps
The preparation for the Steam Next Fest, the localization for 12 languages and the current AI development will be finished around end of February. Afterwards, we will add a second level and take the new feedback (from the Steam Next Fest and from our Alpha Kickstarter backers) into consideration. 

We will than focus on balancing, bug fixing, polishing and prepare the EA release marketing-wise.
Looking at our current progress and our todo list, we are not able to release in Q1 2022, sorry. 

But it is getting really close! 

We are moving the release date to Q2 2022 and expect to provide you an update on this estimation shortly after the Steam Next Fest!

Thanks for your patience! 
Quality first!

We wish everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Enjoy your (hopefully) free days with family and friends and stay healthy 😊

notes.title: Harvest and Controls
notes.content:
During Gamescom a first Fata Deum demo was available for testing and feedback purposes. 
Thanks again for the feedback! This is great support!
There have been two (to be improved ) major aspects, which have been highlighted by many gamers:


Clunky controls
Additional actions during daytime / more interactions with the environment would be great!
	

Directly after the demo period was over we deeply analyzed the feedback and started to improve the game! 

And now a new Alpha build release is available (for Kickstarter Alpha backers)!

Besides many smaller fixes we have mainly focused on improving the controls ( + time control) and add a collecting system, which allows you to harvest resources in the world.

New Controls

We have mostly redone main parts of the camera controls. 
The old control system was more inspired by common RTS-games: the camera was focused on a specific point on the terrain, loking at it from above. We have replaced this approach by a much more FPS approach, so that you can fly through the world as you like. 

As the graphics have improved a lot during the last year of the development, it is ok to get closer, too 😊

Besides this major change, we did a lot of smaller improvements:


Dynamic speed adjustment based on distance to terrain.
Zoom in at mouse pointer
Adaptive zoom based on distance
Right mouse click to move to mouse pointer directly
Fixed bad behavior due to lag.
Improved panning (don’t hassle with selcting building while panning anymore)
Hotkey to deactivate panning
Control is more direct (less damping)
ESC to cancel current ingame menu and to get back from main menu to game directly
Hold STRG to move up and down instead of forward and backward
Separate control for ambient and effect audio volume
…and many more


This sounds a bit theoretically (so hard to show a screenshot or video here..) but it really improved the overall immersive feeling a lot, too.

[previewyoutube=-KGKmpxfdbw;full][/previewyoutube]

And all Fata Deum Alpha backers can try out the new control system right now, a new version is released! We will also provide access to a new demo version in the future.. stay tuned!

All this changes have been done based on your feedback! So we are quite confident, that you will like it 😊

Time Control

We also added a feature requested by the community for a long time: time control!
You can now pause and continue the game by clicking on the world clock icon in the upper right corner! If you hold the left mouse button you can also speed up time!

[previewyoutube=H0qvy_5S9n4;full][/previewyoutube]

Collecting System
A god can get bored once in a while when he is waiting for new mana to perform awesome wonders!
What will he do in the meantime? 
He can now manipulate time itself to get new mana faster.. but that should not be a core game mechanism 😊

Instead we added the collecting system, which allows you to harvest resources from the world to support your followers! You can also move resources from one settlement to another, of course. Or you can sacrifice resources on your altar to get extra mana!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/90a1a0554db8684ba5daaf08cb8d9c6bfcd1b5bd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/9ac3cd63aa323bea45c2afdb04e0d905ca7e1bf1.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/d7266ae25311735ab45905095da5e1fb8fd74030.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/99f6bd33ea1313ab2ab8e32fb82ef38538848466.jpg

But beware! Resources are not endless! Your followers won’t like it if you take their resources!

Further Improvements

We have fixed a lot of smaller bugs or issues which did occur just on some specific systems and we want to say thank you to each gamer who has to struggle with such very specific bugs and helped us to identify the underlying reason! Thanks a lot!

In addition, we improved tutorial logic and added a part to introduce the collecting system.
And of course: performance.. as always we did some improvements here!

Next Steps

We will now focus on AI (again) and localization! 
Again, development has taken more time as expected, but we are very happy with the result (and regret nothing 😊) and the list of “features to be done before EA release” is getting smaller and smaller 😊

We will try to provide a new update before Christmas and provide you with a release update, too.

Thanks again for the feedback! That is helping a lot to make this game better and better (even before EA release)

Stay tuned!

notes.title: New Alpha Release: Characters, UI and Ancient Relics
notes.content:
After a longer development we are very happy to deliver a huge set of new features! New Characters, new UI, ancient relics and many more!

We are very happy with the progress, but to get this game great (for Early Access) we need to move the release date to Q3 2021 (more details under section Further Development of this update). Quality first!

Characters

All new character models are included in the current Alpha build (mortals, demons and zombies!)
The city is now full of life with our new high-quality models!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/aa02561ff22910bd6e816292ec86b0f4cbe58ad4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/48b6820ddf293b5f2c1e0ac4c4f21b3fb7ce1f18.jpg 

They are very customizable, so that each individual can look different, but you can also see the visual similarities of (distant or close) relatives.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/cc9d974a332fc1f9d854b0aa36284b6e9e395a03.jpg

In addition, many different jobs are represented by different clothes: bakers, blacksmiths, builders, lumberjacks, miners, priests, and many more!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/100e0127f03ae62b1ba5c1f8c1f77425c4e1aabd.jpg

Furthermore, all mortals do now also react on the Imp, which is representing you in the world of Fata Deum! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/7bc03f7b82c46859151443ba9bf46689f6e7332e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/457ec41be8c6ff1efbae800422840a82bde458cc.jpg

Look at the guy in the dark red clothes! This guy does not believe in you, but in the god Violence!

Traitor!

As you can see on the screenshots, we also further improved the graphics by mainly working on the post processing!

UI

The old (very simple prototypical UI) has been replaced by a total new UI! In the following picture you can see its main parts: 

Lower right corner: the main player UI providing information about mana, yin and yang power (special kind of mana you get by doing bad or good stuff) and your current attitude.
Upper left corner:  the player god with current level progress (experience) and follower count and the opponent god (Violence in this case).
Upper right corner: current day and day / night time (many Alpha backers have asked for this one).
Icons on the left side: occurring events (bad wonder executed by opponent, fight ongoing)
Bottom center: some general statements
On screen: tooltip for currently selected item (university).
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/60bdbd06c48bdc4aac661e95440cdc25c0f3a2d1.jpg

By selecting on a building or a mortal a detailed UI is popping up, providing you all necessary information and options.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/21837d04f0d848e0bc846e8464a91f17f52f1924.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/ef00e0bd4a58c9beb285d21639a9ea89967d3c6c.jpg

In addition, the selected item is surrounded by an effect which colors indicated in which god (or gods) the mortals belief in.
If you want to execute a wonder, a detailed tooltip is provided.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/737650e66ab4c67bd9c7334cee24d1a56065ebf3.jpg

Ancient Relics
Besides many smaller improvements on the gameplay we have added one bigger new feature: If you are running low on mana during the day (especially in the early game) you can now check the landscape for hidden ancient relics and convert them to gain an extra mana boost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910396/47ca048918d543eae19926a3563bbc71ffe79d0c.jpg  

Further Development
We are very happy with the current progress, but we will definitely not be able to release the game in April. We believe that some additional months will be very good for the game and the community in terms of quality and fun!

Looking at the necessary steps to achieve the wanted level of quality and quantity we decided to only provide a rough estimation of the upcoming release date and move it to somewhere in Q3 2021.
If we come closer to the third quarter, we will provide an update on this deadline, of course.

During the last weeks we received very positive feedback from our backers regarding the question “Shall we take more time for the sake of quality?” and thereby we look very confident into the future! 
Thanks for the great support!

Our next steps will be to improve out tutorials for the game and provide a public demo.
Afterwards we would like to add a second level and improve the AI!

Stay tuned!

Cheers

Chris
